cloudMarketing.title: From questions to usable work.
cloudMarketing.description: Research with sources. Turn a goal and your files into reports, spreadsheets, and presentations.
cloudMarketing.searchDescription: Read sources alongside the answer and return to the complete conversation.
cloudMarketing.computerTitle: Work that continues in the cloud
cloudMarketing.computerDescription: Follow each step, add guidance, and review the files before accepting delivery.
cloudMarketing.deliveryDescription: Keep each delivery version and its files together, with actual previews and downloads.
cloudMarketing.docsIntro: Start a conversation in Search or Computer mode. Your history and task results stay with your account.
cloudMarketing.docsSearch: Search reads sources and produces answers with references. Expand the Sources panel to inspect them.
cloudMarketing.docsComputer: Computer runs trusted tools in the cloud. It can produce reports, spreadsheets and presentations; arbitrary code and desktop control are not available in this release.
cloudMarketing.docsFiles: Attach CSV, XLSX, Markdown, TXT or a text PDF up to 10 MiB. OCR is not supported. Formula inputs require cached results.
cloudMarketing.docsReview: Review the published revision and download its files. Accepting a revision completes the task. A successful run alone does not complete it.
cloudMarketing.docsControl: Closing the page keeps the task running. Cancel explicitly to stop a run, or add guidance while it is active.
cloudMarketing.docsUsage: Usage includes model retries and delegated work. Calls with unknown usage remain marked unknown. Account limits apply before new execution.
cloudMarketing.docsPrivacy: Files and conversations are private to their resource scope. Product analytics excludes prompts, file content and download URLs.
cloudMarketing.footer: Research clearly. Review what you receive.
cloudMarketing.privacyBody: Conversations and files require authorization. Operational telemetry excludes prompts, file contents, credentials and signed download URLs. Product analytics records limited action categories and does not use session replay. Contact the service operator for retention and account deletion requests.
cloudMarketing.contactBody: For account, data or service requests, contact your deployment operator.
